title: 第177章 “吻我。”
slug: 万一小叔对假千金是柏拉图呢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

那副金丝眼镜很衬他。

矜贵清冷的气质，因为那副眼镜显得更加贵气骄矜。

不知什么时候，两人之间的距离拉得很近。

宋瓷抬眸，抬眸看向面前的男人。

那支冷硬的钢笔横在了她的腰身后，宋瓷下意识地前倾。

眸光轻晃，少女微微咬唇，抬手将男人脸上的眼镜轻轻摘下。

镜片泛着冷色的光，摘下时，便能看到男人那双清冽深邃的眸。

坚实的手臂揽过她的腰身，宋瓷整个人被男人带到了怀里。

隔板将声音全部隔绝。

后排的空间不算小，但是男人身形高大，空间便显现出几分逼仄。

“学会了么？”

男人垂眸看她，语气清冷，听不出什么情绪。

少女晃了晃眸光，澄澈的眸中闪着几分不解与疑惑，看上去无辜又茫然。

“小叔说的……是什么？”

男人垂头：“换气。”

少女闻言，绯红从脸颊一直蔓延到耳尖，眼眶微微瞪大，一双杏眸瞪得滚圆。

昨晚他一直在“教”她。

不仅是教她换气，还要她感受他带给她的。

他教她去适应愉悦，去享受情绪，教她换气才会将吻变得绵长，密不可分。

——宋瓷被迫“学了”一晚。

慌乱地低下头去，少女似乎不想回答这个问题。

两人原本是并肩而坐的，男人手臂稍稍用了几分力道，轻易地将少女托到了自己的腿上。

——他似乎很习惯她这样坐在他身上。

男人的视线落在她的发顶。

少女低着头，声音轻软又颤抖，下意识地又去依赖他：“小叔……”

似乎每次遇到“麻烦”，她总会习惯性地去依赖他。

但不幸的是，此时此刻，当下的“麻烦”，是祝砚铮带给她的。

男人并没有替她“解决麻烦”的意思。

一双墨瞳淡淡地落在她的发顶，语气低沉。

“吻我。”

男人说这话的时候并没有什么别的情绪，坐在他腿上的少女听到了头顶传来的声音，以及胸口处微微的震颤。

宋瓷下意识地去抓男人的衣袖。

男人并未躲开。

今天的祝砚铮戴的是她送给他的那颗袖扣。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Those gold-rimmed glasses complement him very well.

His noble and cool temperament makes him look even more noble and arrogant because of his pair of glasses.

At some point, the distance between the two became very close.

Song Ci raised her eyes and looked at the man in front of her.

The cold pen was placed across her waist, and Song Ci subconsciously leaned forward.

Her eyes flickered, the girl bit her lip slightly, raised her hand and gently took off the glasses on the man's face.

The lenses glowed with a cold light, and when they were taken off, the man's clear and deep eyes could be seen.

Strong arms wrapped around her waist, and Song Ci was brought into the man's arms.

The partition blocks all sound.

The space in the back row is not small, but the man is tall, so the space becomes a bit cramped.

"Have you learned it?"

The man lowered his eyes and looked at her, his tone was cold, and no emotion could be heard.

The girl shook her eyes, her clear eyes flashing with confusion and confusion, looking innocent and confused.

"What did uncle say...?"

The man lowered his head: "Get some air."

When the girl heard this, the blush spread from her cheeks to the tips of her ears, her eyes widened slightly, and her almond-shaped eyes widened.

He had been "teaching" her last night.

Not only to teach her to breathe, but also to let her feel what he brings to her.

He taught her to adapt to pleasure, to enjoy emotions, and to teach her to breathe so that the kiss would become long and inseparable.

——Song Ci was forced to "learn" for one night.

Lowering her head in panic, the girl seemed not to want to answer this question.

The two were originally sitting side by side, but the man's arm used a little strength to easily lift the girl onto his lap.

——He seemed very used to her sitting on him like this.

The man's eyes fell on the top of her hair.

The girl lowered her head, her voice was soft and trembling, and she subconsciously relied on him again: "Uncle..."

It seems that every time she encounters "trouble", she will habitually rely on him.

But unfortunately, at this moment, the current "trouble" was brought to her by Zhu Yanzheng.

The man had no intention of "solving the trouble" for her.

A pair of dark eyes fell lightly on the top of her hair, and her tone was low.

"Kiss me."

The man didn't have any other emotions when he said this. The girl sitting on his lap heard the sound coming from above her head and the slight tremor in her chest.

Song Ci subconsciously grabbed the man's sleeve.

The man didn't move away.

Today Zhu Yanzheng is wearing the cufflinks she gave him.
